raw_response:
The company shows solid profitability (EBIT margin ~23% and net margin ~13%) and adequate liquidity (current ratio ~1.35), supporting operating resilience. However, leverage is meaningful with total liabilities of ~4.4B against equity of ~2.4B (liabilities/assets ~65%), which limits balance-sheet flexibility under stress. Overall, these factors point to a mid-to-lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB+
